queries: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS race_share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM circuit_counts) SELECT circuitId, race_count, race_share, race_share - average_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares WHERE race_share > average_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, circuitId LIMIT 10;

WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races, COUNT(*) AS circuit_count FROM circuit_counts) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total_races AS race_share, 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total_races - 1.0 / t.circuit_count AS margin_above_average FROM circuit_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total_races > 1.0 / t.circuit_count ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, c.circuitId LIMIT 10;

WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races, COUNT(*) AS circuit_count FROM circuit_counts) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total_races AS race_share, 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total_races - 1.0 / t.circuit_count AS margin_above_average FROM circuit_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE 1.0 * c.race_count / t.total_races > 1.0 / t.circuit_count ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, c.circuitId LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only races with a non-null circuitId count as hosted races; the average is across circuit IDs represented in races.
